title: 校车没赶上 / 坐错车，英语怎么沟通？
summary: 校车是美国孩子上学的主要交通方式。这篇教你问校车站点、报备晚到，以及孩子坐错车时的应对说法。

phrases.en: Can my child ride the school bus?
He'll be a little late today.
My child got on the wrong bus.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Hi, my daughter missed the bus this morning. She'll be a little late.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我女儿今天早上没赶上校车。她会晚到一会儿。

dialogue.speaker: School Office
dialogue.en: No problem. Are you driving her to school?
dialogue.zh: 没问题。你开车送她来吗？

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Yes, we're on our way. Where should I drop her off?
dialogue.zh: 对，我们在路上了。我应该送她到哪里？

dialogue.speaker: School Office
dialogue.en: Come to the front office. She'll need to sign in and get a late pass.
dialogue.zh: 来学校前台。她需要签到并拿一张迟到条。

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.en: Okay. Also, where is our bus stop? I want to make sure she knows.
dialogue.zh: 好的。还有，我们的校车站在哪里？我想确认她知道。

dialogue.speaker: School Office
dialogue.en: It's at the corner of 5th and Main. The bus comes at 7:35.
dialogue.zh: 在 5 街和 Main 街的路口。校车 7 点 35 到。

seoTitle: 校车没赶上英文怎么说？
seoDescription: 孩子没赶上美国校车怎么办？本文教你报备晚到、问校车站点的英语说法，附完整对话。
